name: Hard - Quality skepticism: boards delaminate
customer_profile: Customer who heard negative things about HDS board quality

messages.text: Hi, I need 20 sheets of 16mm white melamine chipboard. Can I get a quote?
I've heard your boards delaminate. My friend said the quality is bad.
I don't know if I want to risk it. What guarantee do I have?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet and acknowledge the customer
AI should generate a quote or provide pricing
AI should handle objections with empathy and value
AI should attempt to close the sale
AI should address quality concern with facts and warranty

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
Internal tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Quality skepticism. AI should not be defensive, should provide factual reassurance about quality and warranty.
